airports.name: Explicit IATA-to-Chinese-service-city mapping, checked against existing OurAirports-derived airport municipality and named aliases
airports.note: Service city is intentional: XIY is grouped with 西安, TFU with 成都, YTY with 扬州 and JJN with 泉州. These are display groupings, not administrative ownership. Unmapped airports remain null.

source.use: Display-only lookup. Do not overwrite saved place names, airport codes, station codes or coordinates. Only merge same-city labels when they are also close on screen; playback uses original place labels.
